notes.title: Sufoco is releasing now!
notes.content:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33024181/49d514e694c5ab2156b5b855cae6a63b6b4925d5.png[/img]

[h1]Hello Wizards![/h1]


For the release version, a new and more challenging mode was added! The random rooms mode!

In this mode, if you lose, the game loads a different level to play.
Don't worry, your progress in the levels that you won will be maintained.

Enjoy and a have a magical day!

notes.title: Update! New Skins!
notes.content:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33024181/3738311052020cb1a2a31e1dc0ddf55b5b1530c6.png[/img]

Hello, Wizards! 

Telecube Nightmare just got new skins each with its own characteristic animations.

You have to collect some coins to buy the skins in the main menu.

Now when you defeat an enemy you also earn a coin.

Enjoy and have a magical day!
